title: Well depth
question: At which reservoir depth should the wells be drilled?

options.label: Reservoir at 2500 m TVD
options.notes: candidates: C1-3d, C2-2d, C3-2d, C6-2d, C7-2d, C8-3d; top-ranked (LCOH ranking)

options.label: Reservoir at 3200 m TVD
options.notes: candidates: none; excluded by DesignGuard/verifier: C4-2d

criterion.text: lowest lcoh_per_mwh + lcoc_per_mwh among guard-passed candidates without unmet demand in economics

rationale: lowest lcoh_per_mwh among guard-passed options in economics as identified by TR-013. depth-3200m was rejected because it was excluded by the design guard as shown in TR-013. depth-1500m was rejected because it did not rank as a top-performing candidate in the economic evaluation.
